actual.titulo: WNBA Basketball • Toronto Tempo at Connecticut Sun
actual.descripcion: Toronto Tempo at Connecticut Sun | The Toronto Tempo visit the Connecticut Sun at Mohegan Sun Arena for a WNBA game. Toronto leads the series 2-0 after a 101-97 June win behind Marina Mabrey's career-high 37 points, though Mabrey will miss the remaining four games due to an injury.
